claims.statement: The idea resolves to a personal reading tracker whose purpose is later recall of what was read, not collecting links and not habit-tracking; 8 functional and 5 non-functional requirements across 5 user stories express it.

Every one of the eight assumptions in requirement.md section 8 was decided by the assistant with no user present, so the artifact is complete in form but its premises are unconfirmed; section 8 is the agenda for the first real conversation, not settled fact.

Notes and quotes, not the link list, are the payload that justifies the tool: a link list is cheap to rebuild and years of annotations are not, which is what makes FR-002 P1 and NFR-004 and FR-007 binding.
